PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light:  AUTO-PAGE fired: HIGH - downstream-error-rate (service=inference-proxy) > 5%
ops-bot: auto-resolve check: alert auto-resolved after ~40s (flapping detection) — PagerDuty ticket PD-11987 created and auto-closed by policy
Erin: ack. I saw the PD page. It auto-resolved but it fired twice in 3m.
Raf: seeing short 502 bursts in the proxy loadbalancer logs at 12:03–12:05. dumping sample:```[12:03:10] proxy lb: upstream 10.20.1.5 returning 502 for /v1/generate (latency 1.2s)
[12:03:12] proxy lb: upstream 10.20.3.7 returning 502 for /v1/generate (latency 1.4s)
[12:04:01] proxy lb: upstream 10.20.1.5 returning 502 for /v1/chat (latency 0.9s)```
Tiago: checking node/pod metrics. No mass restarts. CPU stable, a couple of hosts had a brief `ksoftirq` spike.
Erin: quick check on request traces — a few spans show KV-cache miss + backend retry causing timeouts. Probably a transient resource contention on a small subset of workers (3/120).
Raf: customer-impact assessment: in the last 10m, we see ~3 failed requests across 2 tenants (non-paying test accounts). No alerts from customers. Marking impact as low but noise is high.
Erin: agree. This is classic "flapping" where the instantaneous error-rate rule is too sensitive to short bursts. I'll temporarily suppress the alert and open a follow-up to tune thresholds.
ops-bot: suppression engaged by Erin for 15m (reason: transient flapping causing noisy pages)
Raf: creating follow-up ticket -> INFR-2345: "Tune inference-proxy error-rate alert; add sustained window and increase debounce". Assigning to oncall rotation owners.
Tiago: suggested rule: fire when error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 60s OR >5% for 5m. Also add a 30s evaluation window smoothing to reduce noisy spikes.
Erin: good plan. I'll add that to the ticket and attach the trace snippets. Also adding a short runbook step: when alert flaps twice in <10m, auto-suppress and page after oncall ack only.
Raf: pushed a temporary suppression and updated dashboards to show the affected hosts: `host-12, host-45, host-78`. Ops note: these hosts were on a different kernel build from last rollout (could be signal).
Tiago: pinging infra to confirm kernel rollout cohort. @Erin can you add the hosts to the incident notes so infra can triage?
Erin: done — note added to INFR-2345 with host list + logs. Also created a tiny checkpoint alert to watch those hosts specifically for 10m.
ops-bot: PD ticket PD-11987 remains closed (auto-closed). Suppression active until 1769004356.
Raf: since this is low-impact, I'll not escalate to SRE pager. If it fires again post-suppression, we escalate to SRE lead @Tiago.
Erin: handing off remaining watch to Tiago for the next 2h. If you see the page recur, please collect `kubectl logs -n proxy <pod> --since=10m` and post sample lines here.
Tiago: will do. taking over. thanks — I'll monitor and follow up on INFR-2345 first thing after the watch period.
Erin: thanks everyone. TL;DR: transient proxy 502 spike caused flapping pages, low customer impact, suppression + follow-up ticket (INFR-2345) created, runbook update proposed, handoff to Tiago. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty Bot: note: last alert instance auto-resolved at 1769003496
